note: 40-acre fishing lake above the Grand River bottoms in northeastern Carroll County, reached by gravel County Road 361. MDC's map marks primitive camping beside three gravel lots: the boat-ramp lot with the privy, on a grassy point into the lake (the main spot), a lot at the lake's north end and one at its south end. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: designated camping (map symbols + GIS 224) at the boat-ramp lot, pin on it; lakeview kept; phone matches. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual; privy added.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on the area map'; Rule 140 standard, no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101. The 2018 map has three 'Primitive Camping Area' symbols, each beside a parking lot: the boat-ramp lot with the privy (GIS 27 point 224 = stored pin; lot 133, 14 m), the north lot (point 223 / lot 132) and the south lot (point 226 / lot 134); GIS point 225 sits ~120 m south of the south lot with no lot. Imagery: the ramp lot is a gravel loop on a mowed point, roomy for a 23-ft rig.

WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): the ramp-lot camping spot is ~55-60 m from the 40-acre lake, with the lot (day use / ramp) and mowed grass between, so not lakefront. The north lot (223) is ~35-40 m from the lake across mowed grass but is a minor spot; the entry stays at the main lot.
PIN fine: on the ramp lot (GIS 224).
CLUSTERS: all four points are within ~440 m on the one gravel road - no split. No other entry within 3 km.
HORSES: none. ACCESS: gravel County Road 361 to the lots.
PHONE: 'For more information call (660) 646-6122' matches stored.
